<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditReport" name="Final audit report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual audit process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AnnualAudit">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatementsDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central audit team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzeData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductSiteVisits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareStatementsDocuments" name="Prepare financial statements and gather documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide clarifications"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRisks" name="Conduct risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" name="Evaluate all risk types"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" name="All risk types evaluated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" name="Investigate in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeData" name="Analyze data"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" name="Investigation analysis complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" name="Are site visits required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisits"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Site visit path merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge" name="Risk assessment outcome merge"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportApproval" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_RevisionsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatementsDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ComplianceCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatementsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceCheck_Join" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Review" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Discrepancies" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discrepancies_Request" name="Discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">discrepanciesFound</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Provide" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Review" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" name="No discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Task_AssessRisks"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_RiskSplit" sourceRef="Task_AssessRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Financial" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Operational" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Compliance" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Financial_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Operational_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compliance_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskJoin_HighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRisk_Investigation" name="High risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">highRiskIdentified</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationSplit_Analyze" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationSplit_Interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_InvestigationJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzeData" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interviews_InvestigationJoin" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationJoin_SiteVisitDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitRequired" name="Site visits required" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">siteVisitsRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisits" name="Site visits not required" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisits_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitMerge_RiskOutcome" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskOutcome_Compile" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compile_ReviewReport" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReport_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportApproved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reportApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionsRequired" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_ReviewReport" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Archive" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Archive_End" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_AnnualAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Multinational company" processRef="Process_AnnualAudit"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ExecutiveBoard" name="Executive board"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalReportToBoard" name="Final audit report" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Participant_ExecutiveBoard" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
